body.message: the account faf10c757ee21a74ec75aa7dfea6fb0e5eac2e0531e2f442e29974c5798d063a is not visible on the network, so there is no key to sign with. Most often that means it has never taken part in a transaction. Retrying will not change it — the chain answered, and this is its answer.
